Title: NC-series Azure Virtual Machines retirement extended to 31 August 2023

Body.Content:
In August 2021, we announced Azure NC-Series virtual machine will be retired on 31 August 2022. Based on feedback we’ve received from you we are extending the retirement date by one year to 31 August 2023, for the Azure NC-Series virtual machine to give you more time to plan your migration. We also want to share that an additional Azure virtual machine option for migrations will be available in a few months.

Required Action 
Evaluate your best path for migration by reviewing the additional virtual machines option that will be available soon here and take into consideration the new retirement date to give you more time to plan for your migration. 

Help and support 
You can reach us directly at HPC VM Retirement. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
